'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Bill Kafer LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Step 3
* '''Username:''' Taco Bill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
